Trouvez un jeu de la Recalbox sans passe: Find a Recalbox game without using the TV, then pair a badge with it or create its card.
Un badge est posé, mais il n'a pas pu êt: A badge is present but could not be read: try another one.
Un badge posé pendant une partie ne lanc: A badge placed during a game does not start another game.
Un jeu lancé sans carte joueur, même dep: A game started without a player card, even from the Recalbox menu, is quit at once with a message on screen.
Une LED qui montre ce que fait le lecteu: An LED that shows what the reader is doing: ready, pairing, error, end of play time.
Une autre demande est déjà en cours: Another request is already in progress
Une carte joueur posée pendant la partie: A player card placed during another player's game takes the game over: the time counts for the new player from then on, and a message says so on the screen. Otherwise, the card counts for the next game. Note: if the games are quit when the card is removed, removing the game card quits the game.
Une carte par personne : posée avant le: One card per person: placed before the game (or left on the reader for a game started from the menu), it counts their play time.
Une fois le temps d'un joueur (ou de l'i: Once a player's (or the guest's) time is used up, their games started from the menu are quit too. Game cards are always refused.
Une partie en cours sera interrompue. La: A game in progress will be interrupted. The page will reconnect by itself; you will then need to authorize this computer again.
Une résistance de 220 Ω sur chaque coule: One 220 Ω resistor on each colour, except for an LED sold on a small board (KY-016 module): they are already there.
Une seule LED, un anneau ou un bout de r: A single LED, a ring or a piece of strip: they all take the same colour.
Vert quand tout est prêt. Désactivé : le: Green when everything is ready. Off: the light only turns on to signal something.
Verticale, languette en bas (fente en fa: Portrait, tab at the bottom (slot on the front of the box)
Vide : le réglage général. 0 : pas de li: Empty: the general setting. 0: no limit. Warns before the end, then quits the game.
Vos badges et vos réglages sont toujours: Your badges and settings are always kept during an update.
Vos propres visuels de carte : une image: Your own card designs: a card-sized picture (85.6 × 54 mm, PNG or SVG) with a transparent area where the game picture goes. Link a frame to consoles: it is picked for their games.
Votre connexion est en réseau « Public »: Your connection is on a “Public” network: Windows hides other devices there. Settings › Network & internet › Wi-Fi or Ethernet › your network › Network profile type › Private. You can also type the Recalbox IP address, for example \\192.168.1.20\share.
Votre connexion est sans doute en réseau: Your connection is probably on a “Public” network, which hides network devices. Switch it to “Private”: Settings › Network & internet › Wi-Fi or Ethernet › your network › Network profile type › Private. Otherwise, use the Recalbox IP address (START › Network settings), for example \\192.168.1.20\share.
